decisions.reason: The encrypted second channel is core to the firm's stated strategy of binding mobile communication, so it fits the aspiration and no shortfall triggers search.
Mobile PDF signing supports the move toward online contract signing; results are still uncertain, but R&D slack lets the firm carry it.
The multi-layer end-to-end architecture is an integrative framing of the firm's existing stack and costs little to keep, so dropping it offers no benefit.
The email-to-app delivery robot is a niche extension whose uptake is uncertain, but it ties into the secure messaging ecosystem and is cheap to maintain, so it stays for now.

The QR-code hardware token faces pressure as customers shift to app-based authentication and may underperform its aspiration, yet one year is too short to justify dropping it given compliance-driven bank demand.
The payment network compliance suite serves regulation-driven demand from payment and banking customers, which likely keeps results near the aspiration.
